title: Do you have your Owner's Manual? | Mohnish Pabrai at Knowledge Inside podcast - Ep 2

summary: The video argues that Jeff Bezos's strategy of reinvesting cash flows to generate high returns, even when net income appears zero or negative, is a key reason to admire him. This approach suggests a focus on long-term value creation over short-term profitability metrics.

claims.claim: The speaker admired Jeff Bezos for reinvesting cash flows to generate high returns even when net income appeared zero or negative.
claims.quote: Well, what Jeff was doing is he was taking all the cash flows and reinvesting back in the business. So when you looked at net income, net income looked zero or negative, but he never really bet the farm in the sense that he kept it within the constraints of the profitability, but you couldn't see the profit.
